# Mill Forest Dental Group

> Family and cosmetic dental practice in Webster, Texas, serving the Clear Lake area for more than 30 years. Four dentists, one location, accepting new patients.

## Key facts
- Address: 17240 Mill Forest Rd, Suite C, Webster, TX 77598
- Phone: (281) 204-8100
- Email: Office@millforestdental.com
- Hours: Monday 8:00am-6:00pm; Tuesday-Thursday 7:00am-6:00pm; Friday 8:00am-5:00pm; Saturday by appointment; Sunday closed
- Rating: 4.9 stars from 599 Google reviews
- Areas served: Clear Lake, Webster, League City, Friendswood, Nassau Bay, Seabrook, Dickinson, Houston
- New patients: welcomed, often seen within the week
- Emergencies: same-day appointments reserved daily
- Payment: most major insurance billed directly, Cherry payment plans, CareCredit financing, in-house membership plan for uninsured patients

## Dentists
- Jen L. Butler, DDS, FAGD
- Jennifer H. Hermstein, DDS, FAGD
- Samantha J. Tutt, DDS, FAGD
- Andrew Augustine, DDS (certified in nitrous sedation)

## Services
- Preventive: exams and cleanings, fluoride, sealants, nightguards, oral cancer screening
- General: fillings, crowns, bridges, dentures, extractions, root canals, sedation, pediatric care
- Cosmetic: teeth whitening, veneers, bonding, clear aligners (SureSmile)
- Periodontics: gum disease treatment, scaling and root planing, periodontal surgery
- Technology: digital X-rays, intraoral camera, Trios 3D scanner, CBCT 3D imaging, CariVu, DIAGNOdent
